concern: Withholding the XXY screen's clean negative for an unresolvable X dosage
what_this_change_claims: The change WITHHOLDS an affirmative negative; it asserts no new positive finding and introduces no new threshold. Two background facts are load-bearing for the decision logic and are evidenced below. Everything else in the diff is software behaviour, verifiable from the code and its tests.

citations.title: New Horizons in Klinefelter Syndrome: Current Evidence, Gaps, and Research Priorities.
seXY: a tool for sex inference from genotype arrays.
Comprehensive whole-genome analyses of the UK Biobank reveal significant sex differences in both genotype missingness and allele frequency on the X chromosome.

independence_note: Each claim has two agreeing sources with disjoint author lists, different journals and different study types. C1: Blackburn et al. (Clin Endocrinol) and Lucas-Herald et al. (Endocr Rev) share no author. C2: Qian et al. (a method paper introducing seXY) and Chen et al. (an independent UK Biobank analysis of X-chromosome genotype behaviour by sex) share no author and do not share a cohort — seXY was developed on GERA/PLCO data, Chen et al. analyse UK Biobank.

discovery_tool_ladder.consensus: Invoked 2026-08-29; 20 papers returned, retained as a derived record. Supplied both C1 sources.
discovery_tool_ladder.scite: Unavailable — the monthly MCP call quota was exhausted on 2026-08-27 with a reported reset of 2026-09-03, which has not passed. No Scite result was used.
discovery_tool_ladder.fallback: PubMed specialist connector used in Scite's place; every retained record was re-resolved through PubMed eSummary for title, journal, DOI and retraction status.

sanitization: None required. Every retained payload is a public bibliographic record. No genotype, sample, personal or credentialed data is present, and no payload was edited.
